Write 2-process net script — cd polus; cat > .orchestra/tasks/62/w1/integ/net.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# 2-process (+ a late joiner) determinism of the material range (plan C23): host + client on port 8913 (ENet, UDP),
# autotest=materials on both; when the host prints MATERIALS_LATE_READY a third process joins. Every MATERIALS_HASH
# tag the host prints must be printed equal by the client (and the after_join ones by the late joiner too).
# Usage: net.sh OUTDIR [MAP]   (project-relative). Prints NET lines + NET_DONE same=N diff=M missing=K.
cd polus
O=$1; MAP=${2:-glade}; PORT=${PORT:-8913}; mkdir -p $O
G=".hub-tools/godot/godot --headless --path . res://scenes/menu.tscn -- --sandbox --port=$PORT --map=$MAP --autotest=materials"
timeout 1500 $G --host > $O/host.log 2>&1 &
HP=$!
sleep 3
timeout 1500 $G > $O/client.log 2>&1 &
CP=$!
for i in $(seq 1 1400); do
  grep -aq MATERIALS_LATE_READY $O/host.log && break
  kill -0 $HP 2>/dev/null || break
  sleep 1
done
LP=
if grep -aq MATERIALS_LATE_READY $O/host.log; then timeout 600 $G late > $O/late.log 2>&1 & LP=$!; fi
wait $HP; wait $CP; [ -n "$LP" ] && wait $LP
same=0; diff=0; miss=0
while read -r tag rest; do
  for who in client late; do
    [ $who = late ] && [[ $tag != after_join* ]] && continue
    other=$(grep -a "MATERIALS_HASH role=$who tag=$tag " $O/$who.log 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*tag=[^ ]+ //')
    if [ -z "$other" ]; then echo "NET MISSING $who $tag"; miss=$((miss+1));
    elif [ "$other" = "$rest" ]; then same=$((same+1));
    else echo "NET DIFF $who $tag host: $rest | $who: $other"; diff=$((diff+1)); fi
  done
done < <(grep -a "MATERIALS_HASH role=host" $O/host.log | sed -E 's/.*tag=//')
grep -a "AUTOTEST_DONE" $O/host.log $O/client.log $O/late.log 2>/dev/null
grep -acE "SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error" $O/host.log $O/client.log $O/late.log 2>/dev/null
echo "NET_DONE same=$same diff=$diff missing=$miss"
EOF

#!/bin/bash
# Headless regression battery, task 62 wave 1 (= task 59's + the W1 tests):
#  matter_test (58 cards, == equality with the old numbers), impact_law (the impact bot's IMPACT_LAW / law_ checks; the
#  impact bot itself runs in 55's part), hint (MatterHint strings, aim cost), range_test (layout: counts, ids, ground,
#  gaps, glade anchor), boards glade / valley (board cells, conservation, cut through), forms (poles felled, columns /
#  slabs: free pieces fall, volume), matbuild glade / valley (range built, promote, restore, «Убрать всё», hidden far),
#  materials glade / valley (one blow per sample, balance, restore = reference), net (host + client + late joiner on
#  port 8913: MATERIALS_HASH equal), det (law/det.sh into OUT/det + compare.sh against baseline_pre/det1: W1a bit-exact).
# Judge: done lines AUTOTEST_DONE ok=true / fails=0, AUTOTEST_MATTER ok, AUTOTEST_RANGE_TABLE ok=true, NET_DONE diff=0
# missing=0, CMP_DONE diff=0. Wall-clock checks are flaky under load (see 59's / 58's headers): rerun alone first.
# Usage: regress.sh OUTDIR   (then: regress.sh OUTDIR summary)
cd polus
O=$1; mkdir -p $O
GB=".hub-tools/godot/godot --headless --path ."
W=.orchestra/tasks/62/w1
summary62() {
  bash .orchestra/tasks/59/main/regress.sh $O summary
  for f in $O/w1_*.log; do
    [ -f $f ] || continue
    n=$(basename $f .log)
    echo "$n | errors=$(grep -acE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|signal 11|Segmentation' $f) | fails=$(grep -acE 'FAIL' $f) | $(grep -aE 'AUTOTEST_DONE|AUTOTEST_MATTER|AUTOTEST_RANGE_TABLE|AUTOTEST_HINT_DONE' $f | tail -1 | cut -c1-120)"
  done
  [ -f $O/w1_impact_law.log ] && echo "w1_impact_law | $(grep -ac 'IMPACT_CHECK law_.* ok' $O/w1_impact_law.log) law checks ok, $(grep -ac 'IMPACT_CHECK law_.*FAIL' $O/w1_impact_law.log) FAIL"
  [ -f $O/net.txt ] && grep -aE 'NET_DONE|NET DIFF|NET MISSING' $O/net.txt | head -5 | sed 's/^/net | /'
  [ -f $O/cmp.txt ] && grep -aE 'CMP DIFF|CMP_DONE' $O/cmp.txt | sed 's/^/det | /'
}
if [ "$2" = summary ]; then summary62; exit; fi
G="$GB res://scenes/menu.tscn -- --solo"
run() { local name=$1; shift; timeout ${TMO:-900} $G "$@" > $O/$name.log 2>&1 & }
scene() { local name=$1 sc=$2; shift 2; timeout ${TMO:-900} $GB $sc -- "$@" > $O/$name.log 2>&1 & }
